task.claim:
For an imaginary quadratic order O = Z[omega] with omega^2 = tau*omega - n
(tau = D mod 2, n = (tau^2 - D)/4) and beta, gamma in O, the index
[O : beta*O + gamma*O] equals the gcd of the 2x2 minors of
{beta, beta*omega, gamma, gamma*omega} written in the basis {1, omega}, when
that gcd is nonzero. ("For any beta in O, |ker beta on E(F_p)| =
[O : beta*O + I]. This index is the gcd of the 2x2 minors of
{beta, beta*omega, pi-1, (pi-1)*omega}.")
